name: Hot Chili Oil / Szechuan Rayu (Capsaicin Motility Warning)
whyItWorks: Hot chili oil infuses lipid-soluble capsaicin and red pepper extractives into vegetable oil. Capsaicin accelerates small bowel and colonic peristalsis, triggering immediate burning diarrhea, severe abdominal cramping, and rectal irritation.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger Warning: Completely avoid hot chili oils during flares. If craving Asian aroma, use toasted sesame oil.
watchOuts: Potent gut motility irritant; provokes severe burning loose stools.
